provenance.kind: Project-authored controlled material-physics study. All tables are stipulated model observations, not a claim of new experimental or ab-initio results.
provenance.scope: Inference is conditional on the explicit finite model, source identities, units and measurement policy.

model: A laterally patchy overlayer covers area fraction f in[0,1] with one positive thickness d and leaves1-f bare. Normalized substrate intensity at takeoff angle theta from the surface normal is(1-f)+f*exp(-d/(lambda*cos(theta))). Each observation is normalized to the corresponding bare-substrate intensity at that same angle. Ignore elastic scattering, diffraction and lateral attenuation at island boundaries.
fit_and_validate: Use only0and60degree observations to infer f and d. Hold75degrees out of that inversion and predict its normalized intensity. Compare the uniform alternative f=1: infer its single d from the normal observation and require every supplied angle to agree within1e-8absolute intensity.
scope: A controlled planar-attenuation model comparison, not a unique microscopic island-shape reconstruction. Lambda is an input, not jointly fitted.
